einzeiler: Bill Simmons and guests discuss early NBA trends, MVP favorites, and NFL trade deadlines.
kurzfassung: Bill Simmons is joined by Kurt Goldsberry to analyze early NBA season trends, young player dominance, and standout MVP candidates like Luka Doncic. Later, Tom Pelissero joins the show to examine NFL trade deadline moves, including the Chicago Bears' rise and the Dallas Cowboys' organizational struggles. The episode covers a wide range of basketball and football storylines through deep-dive analysis and big-picture takeaways.
stichpunkte: Kurt Goldsberry discusses his new article on the NBA getting younger and the physical toll of modern play
Analysis of Luka Doncic's impressive MVP run and his continued on-court complaining
Oklahoma City Thunder's outlook following injuries and their ability to stay competitive
Ty Jerome's breakout performances and early-season impressions of the Memphis Grizzlies
Surprise success of the Philadelphia 76ers and LeBron James' strong start
Decline of Nikola Jokic's apex and the impact of early-season minutes on veterans
Impact rookies and second-year players outperforming expectations across the league
Tom Pelissero joins to discuss the Chicago Bears as Super Bowl contenders and potential NFL trades

clips.hook: Thirty is the new thirty-five in the modern NBA.
clips.text: The hosts examine how the percentage of playoff minutes logged by players aged thirty and older has dropped significantly compared to previous decades.

clips.hook: A twenty-point scorer on high efficiency is an automatic all-star.
clips.text: The guest argues that regardless of a player's name or experience, anyone putting up twenty points per game with high true shooting numbers belongs among the league's elite.

clips.hook: The Chicago Bears have all the makings of a complete football team.
clips.text: The NFL analyst highlights how the Bears excel across all four basic phases of football, from running and stopping the run to passing and defending the pass.

beschreibung:
The Ringer’s Bill Simmons is joined by Kirk Goldsberry to discuss how the NBA is becoming a young man's game and the problem with injuries. Then, they dive into Bill’s early NBA season takes. Finally, Tom Pelissero comes on with his Pick Six for Week 9 of the NFL season.
